svg.title: Hence P α cαF(δα) = 0 for every additive real offset function, by its four coordinate values. Each two-leg loop Hessian is the sum of two cross-leg curvature products. Shift seat summation so the first leg has common base. Its nonzero supported curvature lies in the one-link enlargement; the other curvature is affine on the loop-enlarged neighborhood: curl T(x + δα) = C + F(x) + F(δα). Charge summation gives zero by TR63 for both leg orders. Signed rotations preserve the argument, with at most one-link support growth.
